settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Switches the UI language. Restart isn't required — the change applies instantly.
settings.intro: All settings are stored locally. Nothing leaves your machine.

searchOverlay.title: Search Overlay
searchOverlay.hint: Hotkey for the global Quick Search overlay.
searchOverlay.hotkeyHintBefore: Click the picker and press the combination you want. Common picks:
searchOverlay.hotkeyHintAfter: Takes effect immediately — no restart needed.
searchOverlay.bangHintAfter: show a web-search row in the overlay. Queries open in your default browser — nothing leaves your machine until you explicitly click the result.
searchOverlay.bangSupported: Supported: Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing, Brave, Kagi, Startpage · Wikipedia, Google Translate/Maps/Images · GitHub, Stack Overflow, MDN, crates.io, docs.rs, npm, PyPI · YouTube, Amazon, Reddit. Off by default — KeepItLocal is local-first; this is an explicit opt-in.

clipboardOverlay.title: Clipboard Overlay
clipboardOverlay.enableHint: When on, a global keyboard shortcut summons a focused clipboard-history overlay anywhere in Windows. Different from the main search overlay — single-purpose list with arrow-key navigation and Enter-to-paste. Press again to dismiss. Off-state disables the hotkey but history continues capturing in the background.
clipboardOverlay.hotkeyHintBefore: Click the picker and press the combination you want. Common picks:
clipboardOverlay.hotkeyHintAfter: Takes effect immediately — no restart needed.
clipboardOverlay.autoPasteHintBefore: When on, pressing Enter on a clipboard entry automatically pastes into the window you were using before opening the overlay — like Win+V's native behavior. When off, the entry is just copied back to your clipboard and you paste manually with
clipboardOverlay.tipBefore: if your chosen shortcut collides with another app (browser
clipboardOverlay.tipMid: = paste without formatting, for example), switch to something else here — the change applies right away.

voiceSection.title: Voice
voiceSection.hint: The offline speech engine is built in — just pick a model below to start dictating.
voiceSection.engineDesc: The offline speech engine ships bundled with KeepItLocal — there's nothing to install. If the Voice tool shows an "engine not bundled" message after you pick a model, this build was made without voice support.
voiceSection.modelDesc: Pick a one-click download below — we fetch the model, unzip it, and point KeepItLocal at the extracted folder. The path auto-fills when the download finishes.
voiceSection.manualPickDesc: Or grab one manually from {url}, unzip it, then pick the folder containing {folders}.
voiceSection.voiceHotkeyDesc: Global shortcut that summons the voice overlay anywhere in Windows. Click to record a new chord — modifiers + a non-modifier key (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+V).
voiceSection.pushToTalkHotkeyDesc: Hold it, say a command, release. Click to record a new chord — takes effect immediately, no restart.
voiceSection.vadExperimentalHint: Skips feeding silence to the recognizer during continuous dictation — saves CPU, but a voice-activity detector can occasionally misclassify quiet speech.
voiceSection.pushToTalkEnableShortHint: Hold a global hotkey to run a voice command: press, say a command, release — it runs. Off by default; same offline engine + model as the Voice to Text tool.
voiceSection.outputModePasteShort: Clipboard + Ctrl+V. Fast and works with any keyboard layout.
voiceSection.outputModeTypeShort: Types the transcript key by key. Best for sensitive text.
voiceSection.voskStep1DescBefore: The engine is bundled at build time when KeepItLocal is compiled with the
voiceSection.voskStep1DescEnv: pointing at an extracted copy of
voiceSection.voskStep1DescEnd: message in the Voice tool after picking a model, this build doesn't include the
voiceSection.voskStep2DownloadDesc: Pick a one-click download below — we fetch the model from alphacephei.com, unzip it, and point KeepItLocal at the extracted folder. The model path auto-fills when the download finishes.
voiceSection.voskStep2DescStarter: is a great starter), unzip it, then pick the folder containing
voiceSection.clearVoskTitle: Clear the saved language pack path
voiceSection.voskNoModel: No language pack installed yet. Voice to Text will show a setup card until one is available.
voiceSection.advancedManualToggle: Advanced: use a custom model folder
voiceSection.cmdDesc: Add your own spoken commands — each presses a keyboard shortcut or opens a URL. They work in Command Mode and Push-to-Talk.
voiceSection.cmdEmpty: No custom commands yet. Add one below.
voiceSection.cmdAppHint: Limit this command to one app (e.g. chrome). Leave blank to work everywhere.
voiceSection.cmdIncomplete: Each command needs both a phrase and an action.
voiceSection.biDesc: Customize the trigger phrases for KeepItLocal's built-in voice commands. Comma-separate multiple phrases; English and Georgian are edited separately.
voiceSection.biResetAllConfirm: Reset every built-in command to its default phrases? Your customizations will be lost.
voiceSection.heavyModelWarning: heavy — best on a capable machine
voiceSection.heavyDownloadConfirm: {label} is a large download (about {size}) and will use that much disk space. Large models also need more RAM to run. Download it now?
voiceSection.downloadsWindowsOnly: One-click downloads are Windows-only in this version. Use the manual picker below or grab a model from alphacephei.com yourself.
voiceSection.userCommandsDesc: Power users can define their own spoken commands in a plain-text file — say a phrase to press a keyboard shortcut or open a web page, and scope commands to a single app. The file reloads automatically when you save it, and opens with a documented template the first time.
voiceSection.userCommandsErrors: Some lines couldn't be read — open the file to fix them:
voiceSection.restoreClipboardHint: In paste mode, put back whatever you had copied once the dictation has been pasted — so dictating into another app doesn't clobber your clipboard. Type mode never touches the clipboard.
voiceSection.vadEnabledHint: Skips feeding silence to the recognizer during command mode and continuous dictation — saves CPU, but a voice-activity detector can occasionally misclassify quiet speech. Off by default; turn it on only if you want the power saving and your microphone is clear.
voiceSection.voiceHotkeyEnableHint: When on, a global keyboard shortcut summons the voice overlay anywhere in Windows — speak a command ("open chrome", "search …") or dictate text. Press again to dismiss. Off-state unregisters the hotkey; the Voice to Text tool still works from inside KeepItLocal.
voiceSection.voiceHotkeyHintBefore: Click the picker and press the combination you want. Default is
voiceSection.voiceHotkeyHintMid: — V for Voice, Alt to stay clear of clipboard's
voiceSection.voiceHotkeyHintAfter: Takes effect immediately — no restart needed.
voiceSection.pushToTalkEnableHint: When on, hold a global hotkey to run a voice command: press, say a command ('open clipboard', 'open chrome'), release — it runs. Like command mode, but momentary — it listens only while you hold the key. Off by default; uses the same offline engine + model as the Voice to Text tool.
voiceSection.pushToTalkHotkeyHintBefore: Click the picker and press the combination you want to hold. Default is
voiceSection.pushToTalkHotkeyHintAfter: Hold it, say a command, release. Takes effect immediately — no restart needed.
voiceSection.outputModeHint: How dictated text reaches your app
voiceSection.outputModePasteDesc: Puts the transcript on the clipboard and presses Ctrl+V for you. Fast and works with any keyboard layout — but it overwrites whatever you had copied, and the dictation is saved in clipboard history.
voiceSection.outputModeTypeDesc: Types the transcript key by key, like a fast typist. Slower for long passages, but your clipboard is never touched — dictation stays out of clipboard history. Best for sensitive text.

onboarding.title: Onboarding & Tips
onboarding.hint: First-run hints you can re-trigger anytime.
onboarding.tourHint: Replays the 6-step product tour that introduces KeepItLocal's features, global hotkeys, and where your data is stored. Auto-shown once on first install — click here to revisit any time.
onboarding.hotkeyPopupHint: Re-shows the popup that introduces KeepItLocal's global hotkeys (Quick Search, Clipboard History, Voice Commands). Useful if you dismissed it too quickly the first time, or if you've changed shortcuts and want a refresher.

toolPacks.title: Tool Packs
toolPacks.intro: Core Search + Chat is always installed. Optional packs apply after restarting KeepItLocal, so disabled packs are not registered or lazy-loaded on the next start.
toolPacks.restartBanner: Tool pack changes are saved. Restart KeepItLocal to reload the enabled-pack list.
toolPacks.installerNote: Installer can create the same enabled-pack state during setup; Settings lets users change it later.
toolPacks.coreFeatures: Search overlay, About, Documentation, Privacy Guide

storage.title: Local Storage
storage.hint: Where KeepItLocal stores local databases and indexes.
storage.intro: KeepItLocal writes app state to local redb databases in your app data folder.
storage.unavailable: Storage paths are unavailable right now.

activity.title: Activity
activity.hint: Every tool action you've run — what, when, on how many files. Audit trail for the local-first promise.
activity.empty: No activity recorded yet. Use any tool that touches files and an entry will land here.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.hint: Local error log for troubleshooting. Copy or save the trail to attach to a bug report — nothing leaves your machine on its own.
diagnostics.copyTitle: Copy formatted log text to clipboard — paste into a bug report
diagnostics.saveTitle: Save log text to a .txt file
diagnostics.openFolderTitle: Open the log folder in Explorer
diagnostics.empty: No diagnostic entries — clean run! Errors and warnings will appear here as they happen.
diagnostics.footnoteBefore: Logs are written to a folder under
diagnostics.footnoteAfter: , one file per day, kept for 7 days. They may include error messages and file paths — never the contents of your files.

storagePrivacy.title: Storage & Privacy
storagePrivacy.hint: See exactly what we've collected, and wipe everything in one click.
storagePrivacy.totalNote: Everything below adds up to this. Nothing leaves this machine.
storagePrivacy.preferencesDatabaseDesc: Encrypted clipboard history, settings, profiles, tool packs.
storagePrivacy.clipboardImagesDesc: Auto-evicted at 256 MB. Pinned items stay.
storagePrivacy.fileSearchIndexDesc: Search database of folders you chose to index — lets you find files instantly without scanning every time.
storagePrivacy.automationDesc: Saved recipes, activity log, generated artifacts.
storagePrivacy.quarantineDesc: Leftover from a past corruption recovery. KeepItLocal set them aside instead of erasing them so you could recover data manually if needed. Wiping below will clear them too.
storagePrivacy.unavailable: Storage insights are unavailable right now.
storagePrivacy.wipeDescBefore: Erases clipboard history, search index, preferences, and automation.
storagePrivacy.wipeDescAfter: the files you've processed with KeepItLocal — only the app's own state. KeepItLocal will restart from a fresh install state.
storagePrivacy.confirmHeading: This wipes everything KeepItLocal has saved.
storagePrivacy.confirmDescBefore: Clipboard history (text + images), pinned items, file-search index, automation recipes, profiles, and all preferences will be deleted. Your actual documents are not touched. KeepItLocal will restart.
storagePrivacy.wiping: Wiping data and preparing to restart…

reset.title: Reset
reset.hint: Restore application settings defaults (in-memory only — does not delete any files).
